content.title: CEOs Flag Jittery US Consumers as Global Tensions Intensify
content.summary: Delta Air Lines Inc. said geopolitical uncertainty is clouding its profit outlook, while United Airlines Holdings Inc. warned that global tensions are beginning to hit some travel demand.  Executives at consumer staples companies Procter & Gamble Co. and McCormick & Co. said shoppers remain cautious.
